source: The Odds Gap raw snapshots export
permission_note: Free for research, modeling, and writing with attribution. Do not resell, repackage as a feed/product, redistribute the raw snapshot, or scrape in sustained bulk.
limitations: The anonymous history window is only seven days.
The file has no outcome, tournament-round, stable match identifier, exchange depth, or traded volume.
Scheduled start times can change; player pair and contemporaneous schedule must be retained.
This snapshot is suitable for parser and forecast-horizon validation, not profitability inference.
